connector.name: MCP Victoriametrics by VictoriaMetrics-Community
connector.registryDescription: MCP Server for VictoriaMetrics. Provides integration with VictoriaMetrics API and documentation
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mcp-victoriametrics:1.18.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the victoriametrics-community account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VM_INSTANCE_ENTRYPOINT
env.description: URL to VictoriaMetrics instance (it should be root URL of vmsingle or vmselect), for example http://localhost:8428 or https://play.victoriametrics.com

env.name: VMC_API_KEY
env.description: Optional: API key from VictoriaMetrics Cloud Console (if you have deployment in VictoriaMetrics Cloud)

env.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated list of tools to disable

env.name: MCP_DISABLE_RESOURCES
env.description: Disable all resources (documentation tool will continue to work)
